The '''pontite crystal mines''' were located in [[Starlit Pass]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum's]] [[Eastern Ice Shelf]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces fought over the [[Pontite crystal/Legends|pontite crystals]] within the mines.
